verdict.rationale: Typesense's full API surface ships in the open-source server under GPL-3.0, which the vendor says you can "self-host free forever" (docs-56, docs-39, gh-2). The install guide documents Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, DEB/RPM packages, binaries, Homebrew, WSL and a Terraform module, and production guidance covers Docker Swarm, monitoring and security (docs-26, docs-6, docs-12, docs-18). Community users ran it locally on a 1M-record dataset and treat it as a lightweight docker-compose option (comm-5, comm-13). Missing for 10: the agent-facing MCP server is documented only for Typesense Cloud, not self-hosted instances; independent hands-on reports of production self-hosting are limited.
